crossRefs.note: For the poor will never cease out of the land. Therefore I command you to surely open your hand to your brother, to…
For you always have the poor with you; but you don’t always have me.
For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.
Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness…
Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go…
Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am…
But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
I opened to my beloved; but my beloved left, and had gone away. My heart went out when he spoke. I looked for him, but…
When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.
